scope: CANN 9.2 built-in versus current 6f599eb3a custom; clean captures only; each PMU role contains 32 cores from one replayed kernel, not independent trials.

optimized_timeline.boundary: Chrome Trace ts/dur in microseconds; displayTimeUnit controls display only. 6 sampled groups (18 role tracks), not all 32 groups. Pipe intervals do not equal PMU instruction counts or PMU active cycles.

cautions: PMU ratios and percent-labelled columns retain original units; NA is null, not zero.
Pipelines overlap; activity and wait ratios are not additive wall-clock decomposition.
Memory counters are tool main-memory request counters, not proven off-chip HBM bytes.
FP/int instruction subclasses disagree with arithmetic type ratios; report total Cube instruction counts only.
AIC MTE3 active bandwidth has near-zero denominator and implausible magnitude; exclude from interpretations.
Pipe timeline does not expose SIMD VF internal instructions; no attribution of STU conflict to a specific VF without ablation.
